executed_original_decoder_functions.adapter: Harness includes unchanged stb_image.h and calls static conversion functions directly; no patched implementation.
executed_original_decoder_functions.16_to_8: upper byte retained, low byte discarded

findings: Primary API offers8bit,16bit andfloat entrypoints, but upstream CLI calls only8bit forcedRGB. No automatic fidelity preservation inferred from decoder capabilities.

RGBA->RGB copies hidden RGB and drops alpha, does not composite. Direct original function confirms transparent red becomes RGB red. This is decoder conversion semantics, not an implementation defect by itself; CLI recipe must account for it.
16to8 discards low byte for all65536 inputs;8to16 maps all256 values to replicated bytes. Conversion is not invertible for arbitrary16bit pixels.
loadf non-HDR route first calls8bit postprocessing, then gamma expansion;16bit LDR precision not established through that API. Source finding, no16bit file decode in this step.
Allocation helpers check many products against INT_MAX; this is not proof of complete resource-budget/cancellation behavior across later decoders.
Failure reason and load/gamma/flip flags are global in this version; no concurrent mutation qualification.
limits: Conversion controls are not full file-decode conformance, memory safety audit or production change.
